range.preliminary_note: This is a preliminary range, not a fixed quote. Numbers are informed by measured site visit, verified material rates and current plans. Pool-adjacent zone: H3 pine to H4 upgrade for the 10 pool-side joists is a $200-300 option — discussed on-site. Next step: select a design service below to move to plan finalisation. Fixed price with locked scope returned within 5 business days of plan sign-off.

design_service_tiers.name: Working Drawings
design_service_tiers.description: Plans + quantities — enough detail to lock scope and return a fixed price.

design_service_tiers.name: Design Pack
design_service_tiers.description: Plans, 3D renders + moodboard — see it before you build it.

design_service_tiers.name: Landscape Concept Design
design_service_tiers.description: Full outdoor concept across the whole site — deck, landscaping and hardscape planned as one.

project_run.lead: From acceptance to handover. Payment schedule applies to the fixed-price contract (returned post-plans).

steps.title: Acceptance
steps.body: Verbal acceptance of preliminary range + selected design service fee moves your project to plan-drawing stage.

steps.title: Pre-start meeting
steps.body: Around 3 weeks before build, your Project Manager runs through site and build specifics with you on site. Triggers the 35% pre-start claim.

steps.title: Materials ordered
steps.body: Once the pre-start meeting is signed off, we order materials.

steps.title: Materials delivered
steps.body: Materials land on site. Triggers the 30% materials claim.

steps.title: Build starts
steps.body: Build commences. Daily updates from site through to handover.

steps.title: Subframe complete
steps.body: Posts, bearers, joists installed and tape-protected. Triggers the 25% structural claim.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: Walk-through, care guide, warranty handover. Final 5% balance due on handover.
